title: Chapter 24 Five Hundred Years Have Passed
content:
Chapter 24 Five Hundred Years Have Passed

After dealing with Ao Qing, everyone immediately withdrew their thoughts.

These have nothing to do with them anymore.

"Lord Lu, I want to know the identity of the person who was promoted to the Heavenly Emperor some time ago?"

At this time, Nangong Fang asked immediately.

Everyone around also looked at Lu Daosheng.

At this moment, in their eyes, Lu Daosheng seemed to have become an omniscient existence.

Hearing this question, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Isn't that person right next to you?"

Hearing this, everyone's heart trembled, and then they all turned their heads to look at Gu Chen next to Lu Xue.

"This senior, who are you?"

Nangong Fang greeted respectfully.

Gu Chen was a figure from a million years ago. Although they have lived long enough, they have lived for only a few hundred thousand years at most, and obviously they don't recognize Gu Chen.

Gu Chen said in a low voice: "Fan Emperor."

"What!"

Suddenly, except for Lu Daosheng and a few others, everyone else screamed.

Fan Emperor!!!

How is this possible?

Didn't Emperor Fan fall in the dark turmoil a million years ago?

"Lord Emperor Fan, what happened back then? You..."

Everyone looked at Gu Chen, their eyes excited and fanatical. He was the pride of the Tianxuan world back then, and he was also the savior of the Tianxuan world.

He was the one who had the most hope of becoming the Emperor of Heaven.

Unfortunately, the sky was jealous of talents, and the dark turmoil took away this most talented and youngest emperor.

But now, the other party is standing in front of them alive, and has already reached the realm of the Emperor of Heaven.

Everyone looked at Gu Chen, wanting to find an answer.

However, Gu Chen just shook his head slightly.

"The past is over."

"I have now joined the Wasteland City, and I am also the master of the daughter of the Lord of the Wasteland City."

Suddenly, everyone was shocked again.

A bold guess lingered in their hearts.

Could it be that this mysterious and powerful Lord of the City saved Emperor Fan.

No, now he should be called Emperor Fan Tian.

In an instant, Lu Daosheng's status in everyone's heart was infinitely elevated.

"Now, do you have any questions?"

"Lord City Lord, I have an unwelcome request."

At this time, Nangong Fang bowed his head and said.

"Tell me."

"Lord City Lord, I want to lead the entire Nangong family to join the Wasteland City."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked and then cursed in their hearts.

This old shameless man.

And Lu Daosheng was also slightly stunned.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng slowly said: "If your Nangong family wants to join the Wasteland City, it can only depend on your own ability. Now that the Wasteland City has just opened, there are many opportunities. You should work hard on your own."

Hearing this, Nangong Fang was relieved.

As long as there is no refusal, it's fine.

"Thank you Lord City Lord for the opportunity. I have no problem."

"What about you?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the others.

The drunk old man and the others shook their heads.

Those who want to know, have already known.

There is no need to ask about the attainment of the Tao. They know that as long as they are in this deserted city, they can attain the Tao with their hands.

However, they also learned a very useful piece of information from here.

The deserted city is just starting out now, and there are many opportunities.

In other words, more and more people will come to the deserted city in the future, and they will become stronger and stronger.

Although they are already the strong men standing at the top of the pyramid in the Tianxuan world, what about outside the Tianxuan world?

Lu Daosheng sent a few people back.

Suddenly, Nangong Fang invited many talented people in the clan to live in the outer city of the deserted city.

And this is also the first family to migrate to the deserted city in large numbers.

At the same time.

Outside the Tianxuan world, in the endless starry sky.

Many terrifying old monsters who were sleeping and had little lifespan woke up one after another, and then their eyes looked straight towards the direction of the Tianxuan world through the layers of void.

Tree of Life? !

God help me!

Suddenly, countless old monsters set off and headed towards the direction of Tianxuan World.

On the wall of the deserted city in Tianxuan World, Huang Shou slowly opened his eyes, and the blood-red long sword in his hand suddenly hummed.

"Finally, some capable guys have come."

Having been seeking defeat for countless years, he was obviously very excited about the strong.

But whether the other party could satisfy him was another matter.

In this way, the deserted city officially began its long development.

As time passed, more and more practitioners came from distant places and entered the deserted city to start practicing hard.

And the deserted city gradually became lively.

As for the practitioners who were unable to enter the deserted city, they also settled in the periphery of the deserted city, where there was also abundant energy and suitable for practice.

In the deserted city, due to the rendering of various sacred trees and pagodas, the interior of the deserted city began to change constantly, not only the environment, but also the qualifications of the people.

Many rare physiques and bloodlines that would only appear in endless years appeared one after another.

With the rise of evil spirits, the life span of the older generation was temporarily worry-free.

Everything has entered the most beautiful moment.

Cultivation does not take time, and soon, five hundred years have passed.

And these five hundred years are five hundred years on the real timeline.

Tianxuan World, Desolate City.

This place has now become the most powerful force in Tianxuan World, and there is no doubt about it.

Countless major forces are trying their best to squeeze into the Desolate City.

At this moment, in the outer city, the busy streets are bustling with people, and it is very lively.

The most famous outer city is the very tall building.

Baihua Building.

The only legal one in the deserted city.

Those who enter here can enjoy the joy of family.

And the owner of this Baihua Building is the heir of the Ji family, Ji Shengcai.

Five hundred years ago, he rented the building and it has soared into the sky. It is said that even people in the City Lord's Mansion often come here to spend.

The poster Ji Shengcai has a very close relationship with the people in the city lord's mansion.

On this day, Baihualou people were full again.

"Get out of here, I fucking came first!"

"Haha, No. 666 has always been my order, and this time it will be no exception."

The two big men immediately started arguing. Judging from this, they seemed to be fighting at any time.

Suddenly, countless passers-by appeared around, took out small stools and melon seeds, and looked at them one by one.

Someone even shouted.

Hit him and hit him.

These people are collectively called melon-eating crowds.

People who don’t mind watching the fun are not bad.

"Get out of here!"

At this moment, an angry shout suddenly remembered.

Hearing this familiar voice, fear appeared in everyone's eyes, including the two quarreling men.

Huangwei, a major super force in Huangcheng.

Its leader Awei is even more a celebrity around the great city lord.

It's over.

This idea appeared in everyone's mind and then scattered.

As they were in place, looking at the sword-holding guards in dark golden robes, the two men were trembling all over.

"Grandmaster Huangwei, please spare me, the villain will never dare to do it again."

"Sir, we won't make arguing anymore, please let me go."

Suddenly, the two of them begged for mercy.

He even stuffed storage rings directly into them and wanted to bribe them.

Seeing this, several Huang Wei was sarcastic and looked calm.

The treatment of Huang Wei is not something outsiders can imagine, so how could he look down on such a little bit of stuff?

"take away."

"If you have anything, let's talk about it in the heavenly prison."

Hearing this, the two of them trembled all over and collapsed in place.

Heavenly Prison.

That was just established hundreds of years ago.

It is said that once you go in, if you want to come out, you must definitely have less skin.

Soon, the two were taken away without any resistance.

Everyone around them sighed.

You two will just go and have fun.

It was obvious that he was new and didn't know anything.

Fortunately, I came to Huangwei this time.

If this is the root of the source, I am afraid that you two will not know how they died.

Root, one of the most mysterious forces in the deserted city.

It belongs to a dark force.

It can be said that it is omnipresent. Most of the members in the root are classified information. Perhaps, the good brothers who are chatting with you and playing games together come from the root.

I complained about some things about Huangcheng to him during the day, and it would be transmitted to the Gen headquarters at night.

It doesn’t take the next day, and you will evaporate directly from the world.

This is the horror of the roots.

The leader is even more of a secret.

Anyway, except for the senior figures in the city lord's mansion, no one has ever seen the true face of Chief Gen.
